text:
marta: Alert fired on Grafana: p99 tokens/sec dropped ~40% for west-eu-serving pool around 21:45 UTC. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/token-slo?orgId=1 :warning:

dexter: saw that, digging into node exporter and NIC errors. Initial glance shows RX errors spike on shard-west-eu-12 around same time.

aditya: any autoscaler events? could be scale-down thrash.

marta: autoscaler logs look quiet, no scale events in the last hour. I pulled the pod list: `kubectl -n serving get pods -l pool=west-eu -o wide` - all pods Ready=1/1.

dexter: attaching the node-exporter snippet I grabbed: ```node=shard-west-eu-12 rx_errors_total: 0 -> 120 in 2m; tx_errors_total similar``` looks like intermittent NIC flaps.

janelle: hmm, we've seen similar pattern when a host had bad cable and packets got dropped -> tokens/sec falls (clients retry slower). Any syslog entries?

marta: grep from /var/log/kern.log on shard-west-eu-12: `e1000e 0000:02:00.0: NIC Link is Down` repeated 6x at 21:44:12.

oncall-luca: I can repro on that host's interface, coordinating with host infra to swap cable. tagging infra-ticket INF-8421.

aditya: for alert noise: current Prometheus rule is `sum(rate(tokens_served[1m])) by (pool)` and we alert on p99 drop relative to baseline. That triggers on infra blips. Suggest smoothing: use 5m rate and require >2m sustained deviation, and add node_exporter network_error filter condition.

dexter: agreed. Proposed rule diff: ```- expr: decrease_in_p99_drop = (p99_tokens / baseline) < 0.6 for 1m
+ expr: decrease_in_p99_drop = (p99_tokens / baseline) < 0.6 for 5m and ignoring(instance) (sum(rate(node_network_receive_errors_total[5m])) by (instance) == 0)```

janelle: also add runbook annotation linking to `k8s node -> host id -> colo ticket` and a dashboard panel that overlays NIC error rate. Helps oncall triage faster.

oncall-luca: infra swapped cable at 21:58, node stabilized, tokens/sec returned to baseline by 21:59. Marking incident resolved in INF-8421.

marta: can we add an automated Grafana annotation when alert fires with the top 3 nodes by error rate? saves manual steps.

aditya: yeah, Grafana annotation via alert manager webhook is doable. I'll sketch it and send a PR to prometheus-rules repo.

dexter: follow-up action items: 1) mute current noisy alert until rule change is deployed (ops-bot: please mute for 1h) 2) PR with rule change and runbook 3) add grafana annotation webhook 4) infra ticket link in alert annotation.

ops-bot: mute request received: mute alert 'p99_tokenssec_drop_west_eu' for 60m. (id: mute-2143658701) :white_check_mark:

janelle: thanks. i'll add the runbook snippet and a sample prometheus query to the ops wiki.

marta: thanks all. keeping this thread as the RCA/coordination artifact. tagging INF-8421, PR-serve-667. :thumbsup:
